svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 08 · San Diego · 03/12 Torrey Pines (Rare)
svg.desc: Wind-bent pines on crumbling sandstone bluffs. You hear the surf long before you see it. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
